## Description {#details}

<p>This file provides a collection of function (or more generally, callable) type erasure utilities supplementing those provided by the standard library in <span class="doxyComputerOutput">&lt;function&gt;</span>.</p>


<p>It provides <span class="doxyComputerOutput">unique_function</span>, which works like <span class="doxyComputerOutput">std::function</span> but supports move-only callable objects and const-qualification.</p>


<p>Future plans:</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>Add a <span class="doxyComputerOutput">function</span> that provides ref-qualified support, which doesn't work with <span class="doxyComputerOutput">std::function</span>.</li>
<li>Provide support for specifying multiple signatures to type erase callable objects with an overload set, such as those produced by generic lambdas.</li>
<li>Expand to include a copyable utility that directly replaces std::function but brings the above improvements.</li>
</ul>

<p>Note that LLVM's utilities are greatly simplified by not supporting allocators.</p>


<p>If the standard library ever begins to provide comparable facilities we can consider switching to those.</p>
